mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts ( user_id, title, content, summary, cover_image, status, scheduled_at, view_count, like_count, comment_count ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{coverImage}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, p.title, p.summary, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, p.title, p.content, p.summary, p.cover_image AS coverImage, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.like_count AS likesCount, p.favorite_count AS favoritesCount FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, summary = #{summary}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
UPDATE posts SET status = #{status}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
